name: iuliandita-mods
description: Claude Code mods you can install one at a time.

plugins.name: delegation-board
plugins.description: A live pane of the session's subagents and teammates: type, model, effort, state, elapsed time, tokens, an optional cost estimate and the task description. It only observes; nothing leaves the machine.

plugins.name: guard-rules
plugins.description: Blocks AI attribution in commits and PRs, direct commits to protected branches, commits under the wrong git identity, and mutating kubectl, helm and terraform calls on protected or unclassified environments.

plugins.name: prompt-gate
plugins.description: Before the main model spends a turn on a vague prompt, a small model, checked by Jev when TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set, says so and asks one short question. Default mode dry only measures. With a key set, the prompt goes to api.typesafe.ai (Jev) from every directory unless jevPaths limits it.

plugins.name: secret-box
plugins.description: Keeps secret values out of the chat: write {{secret:NAME}} in a Bash command and the value is filled in at execution time from the OS keyring, and any known value that still reaches the conversation is replaced with its placeholder.

plugins.name: skill-pick
plugins.description: Names the 1 to 5 installed skills that fit each prompt, as many as the ask needs, with a small model and, when TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set, a Jev score per skill; the log shows how often the main model then loads one. Default mode dry only measures. With a key set, the prompt and skill descriptions go to api.typesafe.ai (Jev) from every directory unless jevPaths limits it.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: A two-row status line in the band above the prompt, in the terminal and in Claude Desktop: model and effort, worktree, branch and counts, lines changed, kube context, PR and issue counts, session name and output style; then context, 5h and 7d rate-limit bars with pace, cache, cost and time. No statusLine script. In a git repo with a GitHub or GitLab remote it runs gh or glab for the PR and issue counts (forge option, on by default).
